title: fix(app): write runtime data to LOCALAPPDATA, not read-only Program Files
body:
## Summary

The installed app crashed on launch:
```
PermissionError: [WinError 5] Отказано в доступе: 'C:\Program Files (x86)\data_bridge'
```
`app_entry.py` did `os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(BASE_DIR)/"data_bridge")` — when installed in `C:\Program Files (x86)\SmartZonesPro`, that resolves to `C:\Program Files (x86)\data_bridge`, which is read-only without admin. The same problem affected `brokers.json` / `.env` (saved under `PYTHON_CORE_DIR`) so Settings couldn't persist either.

### Fix
Split read-only resources from writable data in `paths.py`:
- `BASE_DIR` (install dir) — read-only bundle (mql/, .env.example, templates).
- New `DATA_DIR` — writable: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\SmartZonesPro` when frozen, repo root from source, override via `SZP_DATA_DIR`.

`DATA_BRIDGE_DIR`, `LOCAL_DATA_DIR`, `OUTPUT_DIR`, `ZONES_FILE`, `BROKERS_FILE`, `ENV_FILE`, flags now live under `DATA_DIR`.

`app_entry.py` no longer builds the path from `dirname(BASE_DIR)`; it just calls `paths.ensure_dirs()`.


Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/f48c43f7f9474274952454becc948460
Requested by: @VadimChudin
